decision_evidence_summary: Built the full admissible process window: 14136 states over T=350-450 C, P=20-1000 bar, Tsep=-40 to 30 C.
Computed reference activities for all 15 candidates; candidate_04 has the highest atomic activity.
Optimized all 15 candidates in the full window; only candidates 13, 04, and 05 are feasible under the 90 m3 bed cap.
candidate_13 is lowest canonical cost at 15.2917 USD/t, ahead of candidate_04 by 6.7389 USD/t and candidate_05 by 10.5401 USD/t.

Because highest-activity candidate_04 is not the lowest-cost candidate, BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY were executed. Parity requires a 201.2x intrinsic-activity gain, while the frozen descriptor manifold offers at most 2.52x across process states, so parity by intrinsic activity alone is unreachable.

Remaining affordable calculations would mainly quantify sensitivities/uncertainty rather than change the canonical frozen-descriptor industrial decision.

unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty: Descriptor uncertainties were read but Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation was not run; this leaves probabilistic robustness unquantified.
